Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in the very first step by incorrectly identifying the composer of the song "How Long Has This Been Going On?" as George Gershwin. The song was actually composed by Sam Cooke (with lyrics by Cooke and his brother Charles). George Gershwin died in 1937, long before Sam Cooke was born (1932). This fundamental error in identifying the subject of the query led the entire subsequent investigation to focus on the wrong person, despite the WebSurfer eventually finding the correct death place for Gershwin (Hollywood, CA) and the correct death place for Sam Cooke (Los Angeles, CA), the Planner's initial misidentification rendered the task's premise false from the start.
